summary: Sprint 22C — Homepage Layout Editor — full regression sweep. 13/13 backend pytest cases passed (GET public/no-auth, PUT auth-required, PUT reorder+override persistence, validation for duplicates/unknown/missing keys with auto-append, POST reset, regression on /api/content and /api/menu). Full frontend end-to-end exercise passed: public homepage renders all 9 default sections in canonical order, Layout tab renders 9 rows with correct Up/Down disabled states on first/last, edit-copy reveals title+body inputs, Save persists + emits success toast, reorder marks editor dirty + Discard restores state, hiding a section (specials) removes its <section> from public DOM, title/body overrides on About reflect verbatim on public site. Layout reset to canonical state after testing — DB confirmed clean.
critical_code_review_comments: cms.py — `_layout_with_meta()` always re-sources `label`/`supports_*`/`note` from the seed module, which is the right call (admins can't drift the schema). Good defensive design.

cms.py PUT — duplicate detection uses `seen.add(k)` inside a list-comp side effect; works but is slightly tricky. Consider `from collections import Counter; dupes=[k for k,c in Counter(submitted_keys).items() if c>1]` for readability. Non-blocking.

cms.py PUT — auto-append for missing keys uses set iteration order (`_ALLOWED_SECTION_KEYS` is a set), so appended order is not deterministic. Verified that submitted keys preserve order but the auto-appended tail order varies run-to-run. Not user-visible since admin would never intentionally submit a partial list, but for stability consider iterating `DEFAULT_HOMEPAGE_LAYOUT_SECTIONS` when computing missing.
seed_data.py — `seed_defaults` is idempotent for homepage_layout (only inserts when doc missing). Good.

LayoutTab.jsx — verified all required data-testids present (layout-section-list, layout-row-{key}-{up|down|toggle-visible|edit-toggle|title-input|body-input}, layout-save-btn, layout-reset-btn, layout-discard-btn, layout-dirty-flag, layout-toast). No issues.
test_credentials: Admin password from /app/memory/test_credentials.md ([REDACTED]) — used once via API to mint a token, then reused; no rate-limit issues.
seed_data_creation: None — pure layout doc mutations, all rolled back via POST /api/homepage/layout/reset at end of run. Confirmed clean state in DB: canonical order, all sections visible, no title/body overrides.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pytest module test_sprint22c_layout.py is module-scoped for auth and runs a teardown reset at end; safe to re-run anytime. Public GET, PUT auth, PUT validation (duplicates / unknown / auto-append missing), title/body strip, visibility persistence, reset, regression on /content + /menu all covered. Frontend testids list in critical_code_review_comments. Note: the Promote dashboard tab uses id='promotions' (testid='tab-promotions', not 'tab-promote') — common gotcha when scripting regression checks on the tab bar.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Both manual verification by E1 and this independent cross-cutting sweep confirm Sprint 22C behaves as specified.
